posts.text: 🤖 AI Platform Dave Eggers told OpenAI staff that ChatGPT was ‘silencing an entire generation’ The Verge – AI · 🟢 ChatGPT · 5h ago • Dave Eggers warned OpenAI staff that ChatGPT risks silencing creative voices and suppressing an entire generation of writers. • Author and founder of McSweeney's was invited by Sam Altman to address ~200 OpenAI employees about AI's impact on creative industries. • Discussion highlighted concerns about generative AI's effect on writers, journalism, and the broader arts ecosystem.
